page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.13xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud instance configured on x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. The compute subsystem is powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, providing 52 dedicated vCPUs. The hardware configuration delivers 384.0 GB of system memory, establishing a density of approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per vCPU to maintain high memory capacity relative to compute allocations.

The instance does not feature bundled local storage, requiring persistent operational data to rely entirely on external block storage services. Networking capabilities feature a baseline network throughput of 12 Gbps. There are no discrete GPU accelerators integrated into this server type, and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned by default.

Qualitatively, the server optimizes resource expenditure for environments where working memory requirements significantly outpace CPU scaling demands, avoiding the need to pay for superfluous processing cores. This platform fits large-scale memory-centric workloads, including in-memory databases, distributed key-value caches, enterprise data processing, and large analytics engines.
